classification.difficultyReason: Apply the explicitly supplied increase of two to the last term repeatedly, using the suggested number line if needed.

content.prompt:
The sequence $-15,-13,-11,\ldots$ is ‘going up by twos’. Write down the next three terms.

(Draw a number line to help you.)

answer.worked:
Move two units to the right for each new term:

$$\begin{align*}-11+2&=-9\\-9+2&=-7\\-7+2&=-5\end{align*}$$

The next three terms are $-9,-7,-5$.

spec.description: Supporting unit number line with the next three sequence terms marked.
